name: Ayase Kyouko
source:
Kusunoki Obstetrics & Gynecology Doctor
Single
Reputable doctor
Strong willed

She was ordered to dope Onisuke and administer drugs to the hostages, assisting him in his crimes. She herself ended up being drugged.
